MIDDLE: Close the eyes again as the camera makes a small handheld jolt, then press the lips into a skeptical pout.

ENDING: Hold the furrowed-brow, wide-eyed stare and pursed lips as the camera moves lower and much closer.

CAMERA: Use a continuous handheld movement into a lower, tighter off-center close-up.

ENDING STATE: The performer holds a skeptical pout and wide-eyed frown in a very tight off-center crop.

CONSTRAINT: Keep both hands outside the frame. Do not add a gesture or switch to a new shot.

MIDDLE: Make a brief side glance, return the eyes to the lens and blink, keeping the hand over the lower face.

ENDING STATE: The eyes remain wide in a tight close-up, with the same hand covering the lower face.

CONSTRAINT: Do not uncover the mouth or switch hands during the camera movement.
